newsitem.title: GERMANY: German traders make no bid for intervention grain. [CORRECTED 11:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: German traders make no bid for intervention grain. [CORRECTED 11:32 GMT]

text.p: German grain traders made no bids for intervention exports on Thursday, state grain intervention board BLE said.
"No bids came in today," a BLE official said.
German traders also bid for 22,000 (Corrects from 220,000) tonnes of free market soft wheat, at rebates of 15.98 to 19.78 Ecus a tonne, at this week's EU export tender, BLE said.
Bids were also made for 22,500 tonnes of barley at rebates of 26.94 to 30.25, BLE said.
